scope: Bounded synthetic exact-image timing and pixel correctness; no games, headset, codec, TCC or optical latency/FPS measurement
mapping: HLFT v1 in unchanged v6 reserved header; optional exact frame/epoch/clock metadata
runtime_execution: Direct explicit copied runtime negotiation plus per-process XR_RUNTIME_JSON and unique HALLIDAY_BRIDGE_PATH; no runtime registry registration

D3D11.verified: Exact selected prior pixels, submitted xrEndFrame display time, frame index and producer epoch; mixed formats/crop/array/mirrors/recenter/focus/quad/empty transitions and cleanup

D3D12.fixture: Three swapchain source frames plus paired resubmissions and existing small lifetime/quad checks
D3D12.verified: Exact prior submitted display time with prior pixels/eye geometry, actual app queue rendering and normal teardown

Vulkan2.verified: Exact selected prior timestamps/epoch/frame pixels; four formats and all flips, paired submit/fence counts, arrays/crops, session reset/reconnect and teardown

limits: Correctness checks only; no causal game FPS, optical latency or physical comfort claim.
OpenXR time denotes submitted intended presentation, not engine simulation time.
Private copied fixtures and provider binaries are not included in this source contribution.
